intro: Most “bugs” are path or day mismatches: logged in the wrong place, viewed the wrong day, or saved rows without kcal. Walk the checklist before you lose a week of patience.
buddyTip: Reproduce once on Home with a simple meal that has clear kcal. If Progress moves, the system works — fix the path, not your motivation.
mission: If something feels broken, run the three checks: Home log path, selected day, kcal on the row.
why: Troubleshooting skill protects Consistency over Intensity. People quit when they think the product ignored their effort — often the effort landed in an empty row or another date.
Sync delays, offline moments, and confirm-skipped voice drafts also confuse. A short ritual finds the cause without shame.
When it’s truly stuck, hello@kcal.lol helps faster if you can say what you tried: device, day, whether Home or Foodiary, and a screenshot if possible.

points: Progress at 0 — blank kcal, placeholders, or no Home log
Wrong day — late logs / selected date mismatch
Voice/camera draft not saved — confirm skipped
Meal Plan vs diary confusion — intent logged as intake (or intake never logged)
Sync / reinstall surprises — auth and recovery gaps

misconceptions.myth: If Progress is 0, my data is gone.
misconceptions.truth: Often the data is in Foodiary on another day or without energy fields. Inspect before panicking.
Reinstall without a clear auth/recovery plan can make things worse. Diagnose first.

steps: Log one known meal on Home with Buddy; confirm save
Open Foodiary for today — see the row and its kcal/protein
If empty: check selected day; fix blank-kcal rows; avoid duplicate manual empties
For voice/camera: retry and explicitly confirm
Still stuck: note device + time + what you tapped; email hello@kcal.lol
how.buddyHelps: The Quick Guide (WHAT / WHY / HOW) matches this path. Buddy capture with nutrition is the fastest proof the loop is alive.

sections.title: Progress at 0
paras: Blank-kcal Foodiary rows do not feed Progress. Prefer Buddy logs from Home. Edit rows to include energy or delete useless placeholders.

sections.title: Wrong day
paras: Check the date control in Foodiary. Late-night entries may sit on yesterday or tomorrow relative to your mental model. Align the day you’re judging in Progress.

sections.title: Sync and auth
paras: Confirm you’re on a trusted/paired device and online long enough to sync. If you switched phones, finish pairing before declaring data missing.

mistakes.quote: I added five empty Foodiary lines to “force” Progress.
mistakes.why: Empty lines add noise. One complete Buddy log teaches more.

mistakes.quote: I emailed support with only “it doesn’t work.”
mistakes.why: Path, day, and screenshot cut resolution time dramatically.

mistakes.quote: I stopped logging for a week until it’s fixed.
mistakes.why: Try the Home proof log first. Often you’re unblocked in two minutes — and gaps hurt learning.

encouragement: You are not failing the app. Walk Home → Foodiary → Progress once with a real meal. Most mysteries end there — and Buddy will be waiting at the next log.
